newsitem.title: FRANCE: Brest tables strong air cargo growth in Jan-Oct.
newsitem.headline: Brest tables strong air cargo growth in Jan-Oct.

text.p: Brest's Guipavas Airport said it handled 2,729 tonnes of cargo traffic in the first ten months of 1996, an increase of 24.2 percent on the same period last year.

One of the main factors in the growth this year has been the exports from Brittany to Paris, the south of France and Corsica, transported in passenger services, an airport authority official told Reuters.
January-October 1996 postal traffic handled at Brest Airport was up 1.1 percent in the first ten months of last year at 1,645 tonnes, the airport authority said.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail bnetween its Paris Charles de Gaulle hub and Brest on a regular basis using five-tonne capacity Fokker 27 aircraft. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
